notes: Catalog number SBWD1100P (SBWD1100PCA for Canada). Official manufacturer datasheet lists Interfaces as: 1x HDMI Input, 1x HDMI Output, 1x Analog 3.5mm audio Output, 2x USB 2.0 Host Type-A, 1x USB 3.0 Host Type-A, 1x DC Power Jack, plus Ethernet 10/100/1000-BASE-T RJ-45 LAN (listed separately under Wireless/Ethernet spec row, not the Interfaces row). HDMI version (1.4/2.0/2.1) is not stated in the datasheet — only max resolution (4K@30Hz), H.264 compression, and HDCP 2.x are specified, so HDMI grade is omitted rather than inferred. USB 3.0 Host Type-A graded usb-5g (USB 3.0 = 5Gbps); USB 2.0 ports graded usb-2.0. Ethernet graded eth-1g per explicit "1000-BASE-T" spec. Power input is a barrel-style DC jack rated 12VDC/3A (consumption 8.4W typical, 36W peak), modeled as dc-barrel. Desktop puck-style unit (8.66 x 5.66 x 1.47 in) - not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Device combines wireless-display receiver + HDMI switching/pass-through + UC/conferencing bridge; classified here as Converter/Encoder-Decoder category since core function is wireless-to-HDMI signal conversion, though it also functions as a network-connected collaboration endpoint.
